nativeESM.scope: Packed local workspace artifacts consumed through native browser ESM/import maps in three Playwright engines. Selective dependency closure, class/catalog side effects, compatible registrations, collision preflight, one/two related/unrelated imports, shared module requests, horizontal/vertical split keyboard and mouse behavior, checkbox keyboard/pointer/FormData behavior. Not scoped-registry, SSR, all-component, current-minus-one browser/framework, or manual assistive-technology acceptance.

priorAttempts.outcome: Missing isolated lab esbuild installation; no browser qualification. Installed existing locked dependencies.
New failure test incorrectly expected unupgraded ElementInternals form submission. Corrected to documented input-only continuity; no product change.
21 native ESM/53 consumers passed,1 native-registry skip. Final run additionally executes pathway-selection contract.

limitations: Firefox native scoped-registry capability test skips; global fallback and both SSR delivery cases pass.
Unupgraded shadow input remains editable after failed import, but ElementInternals submission/reset requires successful upgrade; application owns no-JS form fallback.
Current-minus-one retail browsers, physical hardware, screen-reader speech and complete catalog coverage are not inferred.
Historical external CSS-authoring rerun remains user-retired, not passed.
